entityMappings.reasoning: record_type column discriminates DBLP bibliographic entity types. Each value maps to a specific FaBiO class (article→JournalArticle, inproceedings→ConferencePaper, etc.). The parent class fabio:Expression covers all.
DBLP article records are journal articles — direct match to fabio:JournalArticle (subclass of fabio:Article)
DBLP inproceedings are conference papers — direct match to fabio:ConferencePaper (subclass of fabio:ProceedingsPaper)
DBLP proceedings are conference proceedings volumes — direct match to fabio:ConferenceProceedings
DBLP book records map directly to fabio:Book
DBLP incollection records are parts of books (chapters, reference entries) — fabio:Chapter is the closest FaBiO class for book section contributions
DBLP phdthesis maps directly to fabio:DoctoralThesis (subclass of fabio:Thesis)
DBLP mastersthesis maps directly to fabio:MastersThesis (subclass of fabio:Thesis)
DBLP www records represent web/person pages — fabio:WebContent (information primarily for web manifestation) is the closest FaBiO class
DBLP data records represent datasets/data publications — fabio:DataFile (realization of a fabio:Dataset) is the best match
journal column contains journal names (2,061 unique values) — each represents a fabio:Journal venue entity
booktitle column identifies proceedings/collection venues — maps to fabio:AcademicProceedings (parent of ConferenceProceedings and WorkshopProceedings)
series column contains publication series names (1,814 unique) — maps to fabio:Series (sequence of expressions identified as a group)

attributeMappings.reasoning: DBLP key is a unique identifier for each record — maps to dcterms:identifier
DBLP mdate is the metadata modification date — maps to dcterms:modified
Title column maps directly to dcterms:title — standard Dublin Core title property
Year of publication maps to fabio:hasPublicationYear with gYear datatype
Pages field (e.g., "815-819") maps directly to prism:pageRange
Volume identifier maps directly to prism:volume
DBLP number field typically represents journal issue number — maps to prism:issueIdentifier
Month of publication contributes to prism:publicationDate — partial date information
ISBN field maps directly to prism:isbn
DBLP ee field contains electronic edition URLs (usually DOIs) — maps to fabio:hasURL
DBLP url field contains DBLP page URLs — maps to fabio:hasURL (second URL property for DBLP-internal link)
DBLP note field contains supplementary textual information — dcterms:abstract is the closest standard property for descriptive text, though notes are not always abstracts
CD-ROM path is a resource locator — fabio:hasURL is the closest property for resource location references
Publication number is a sequence/identifier within a context — maps to fabio:hasSequenceIdentifier

relationshipMappings.reasoning: Authors are the primary creators of works — dcterms:creator is the standard property (declared as objectProperty in ontology with open domain/range)

Editors are contributors/creators of proceedings and books — dcterms:creator covers this role. Note: foaf:Person is from a declared namespace but not an ontology class; relationship target will use string literals if Person class unavailable
Publisher column maps directly to dcterms:publisher object property declared in the ontology
DBLP crossref links a paper to its parent proceedings/journal volume — frbr:partOf expresses part-whole containment between FRBR endeavours
DBLP cite field lists referenced works — frbr:relatedEndeavour captures the generic relationship between bibliographic entities
Journal articles are part of journals — frbr:partOf models the containment relationship
Conference papers are part of proceedings — frbr:partOf models the containment relationship
Publications belong to series — frbr:partOf models the membership relationship

unmappedColumns.reason: publtype is a DBLP-specific publication subtype qualifier (e.g., encyclopedia, informal, withdrawn) with no direct FaBiO data property match
unmappedColumns.suggestion: Could be used as a secondary classifier to refine entity type selection during graph generation. Consider mapping to a SKOS concept if needed.

unmappedColumns.reason: school represents the academic institution for theses — no direct FaBiO property for institutional affiliation
unmappedColumns.suggestion: Use as a literal attribute on Thesis entities. In the graph generation step, this could be stored via a custom annotation or linked to a foaf:Organization if the ontology is extended.

unmappedColumns.reason: chapter column has only 2 values in 12.3M rows (effectively empty) — negligible data
unmappedColumns.suggestion: Can be safely ignored. If populated, could map to fabio:hasSequenceIdentifier.

unmappedColumns.reason: address column has only 3 values (all "New York") with 100% missing rate — negligible data coverage
unmappedColumns.suggestion: Can be safely ignored due to near-zero coverage. If needed, fabio:hasPlaceOfPublication (object property to frbr:Place) could model this, but frbr:Place is not a declared class.

unmappedColumns.reason: stream is a DBLP-internal repository/source stream identifier with no ontology equivalent
unmappedColumns.suggestion: DBLP-specific metadata. Could be stored as dcterms:identifier with a qualifier, but this would overload the property. Recommend flagging for review.

unmappedColumns.reason: rel contains DBLP-internal related record keys (99.95% missing) — sparse cross-reference with no specific FaBiO property
unmappedColumns.suggestion: Could potentially be modeled via frbr:relatedEndeavour during graph generation if values are resolved to known keys.

recommendations: 6 columns unmapped — review if any contain critical domain data
During graph generation, use record_type values to instantiate specific FaBiO subclasses
Authors/editors should be split on "|" delimiter to create individual Person entities
The ee column often contains DOI URLs — extract DOI identifiers using prism:doi during graph generation
